channel.title: The Grant Desk - Open Calls, Film & Video, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Open Calls, Film & Video, Africa, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Producers Track)
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.
  • Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Short Film Track)
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.
